name: Use of mixers, privacy coins or privacy pools around platform activity
description: Funds pass through mixers, privacy coins or privacy-preserving pools before or after platform activity without commercial rationale.

links.name: Use of privacy tools between market exposure and exchange deposit
links.ctx: Funds from market clusters pass through mixers or privacy coins before arriving at the platform.

links.name: Use of privacy-preserving or zero-knowledge pools
links.ctx: Value passes through pools designed to hide linkage, immediately before or after platform activity.

links.name: Preference for privacy-enhanced coins with no commercial rationale
links.ctx: Customer converts mainstream assets into anonymity-enhanced coins and withdraws them, or requests such assets despite a simple stated purpose.
links.fp: Privacy-conscious users; genuine holdings of such assets.

links.name: Use of mixers or privacy tools before purchasing NFTs
links.ctx: Purchase funding traces through obfuscation services.

links.name: Large conversion into privacy coins or mixer use after receipt
links.ctx: Receipts are converted into privacy-enhanced assets or sent to mixing services before exit.
